title: Oxidative DNA cleavage mediated by a new unexpected [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex (BAPP = 1,4-bis(3-aminopropyl)piperazine): crystal structure, DNA binding and cytotoxic behavior.
authors: Ragab, Mona S; Shehata, Mohamed R; Shoukry, Mohamed M; Haukka, Matti; Ragheb, Mohamed A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型钯配合物的DNA结合与氧化切割及细胞毒性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主，仅含简单分子对接，与课题核心匹配度低。
abstract: A novel Pd(ii) double complex, [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)], containing the 1,4-bis(3-aminopropyl)piperazine (BAPP) ligand is investigated. X-ray crystallography of a single crystal confirmed the structure of the [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex. The spectroscopic behavior was also elucidated using elemental analysis, nuclear magnetic resonance and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry. The antimicrobial susceptibility of the [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex against all tested microbial strains was lower than that of the BAPP ligand except for C. albicans. The cytotoxic impacts of the BAPP ligand and its [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex were evaluated in vitro for HepG2, CaCo-2 and MCF7 cell lines as well as the WI-38 normal cell line. The anticancer activity was markedly improved by the complexation. The [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex could selectively inhibit the tested cancer cells in a safe way to the non-tumorigenic cell (WI-38). From the DNA binding studies with ultraviolet-visible spectrophotometry, the [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex interacts more efficiently with the calf thymus DNA than its BAPP ligand through the intercalative binding mode. In the absence of an external reductant, the [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex cleaved the intact supercoiled pBR322 DNA under physiological conditions in a concentration-dependent manner. Additionally, electrophoretic experiments were performed in the presence of different radical scavengers, namely DMSO, NaN(3) and KI, and ruled out the hydrolytic mechanistic pathway of the reaction and suggested that the oxidative mechanism is the preferred one. The results of the binding affinity of the [Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)] complex to human DNA were modeled using a molecular docking study showing that the complex interacts more strongly with human DNA than the ligand. Finally, an in vitro pharmacokinetic study was assessed through in silico ADME predictions.
abstract_zh: 研究了一种新型Pd(II)双配合物[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]，其含有1,4-双(3-氨基丙基)哌嗪（BAPP）配体。单晶X射线晶体学确认了[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物的结构。通过元素分析、核磁共振、傅里叶变换红外光谱和质谱法阐明了其光谱行为。除白色念珠菌（C. albicans）外，[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物对所有测试微生物菌株的抗菌敏感性均低于BAPP配体。在体外评估了BAPP配体及其[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物对HepG2、CaCo-2和MCF7细胞系以及WI-38正常细胞系的细胞毒性影响。配合作用显著提高了抗癌活性。[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物能够以对非致瘤细胞（WI-38）安全的方式选择性抑制所测试的癌细胞。通过紫外-可见分光光度法的DNA结合研究表明，[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物通过嵌入结合模式比其BAPP配体更有效地与小牛胸腺DNA相互作用。在无外部还原剂的情况下，[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物在生理条件下以浓度依赖性方式切割完整的超螺旋pBR322 DNA。此外，在存在不同自由基清除剂（即DMSO、NaN(3)和KI）的情况下进行了电泳实验，排除了反应的水解机制途径，并表明氧化机制是优先途径。通过分子对接研究模拟了[Pd(BAPP)][PdCl(4)]配合物与人DNA结合亲和力的结果，显示该配合物比配体与人DNA的相互作用更强。最后，通过计算机ADME预测评估了体外药代动力学研究。
